origin.title:
Before building systems,
I built my own room.
paragraphs: As a teenager, I worked in construction to help my parents, both on outside jobs and in our own home. We partitioned our house to rent out space more than three times. Through almost every one of those changes, I built my own room.
For a long time, I lacked some of the foundations I needed to pursue my dreams. Maybe that is why I now love creating that kind of support — for myself and for others.
My parents worked with bricks, mortar and, sometimes, drywall. I wanted to take that experience into another kind of construction: organizations, tools and systems that open paths for more people.
origin.bridge: The materials changed. The desire to build a foundation did not.

projects.name: Sistema San
projects.status: Work in Progress · pilot in one municipal network
projects.built: An AI planning platform that turns education data into class-level lesson plans, mock exams and student reports.
projects.summary: An AI platform that automates pedagogical planning for public schools. From government education data, it generates class-level lesson plans, mock exams and individual student reports.
projects.subtitle: From government data to planning for every public-school classroom.
projects.problemTitle:
Plan for the class.
See every student.
projects.problem: Pedagogical planning needs to connect network-level information, the needs of each class and individual follow-up. Sistema San uses AI to automate that preparation and bring plans, mock exams and reports into one management system.
projects.caveat: This is a pilot, not evidence of improved learning outcomes or measured time savings. The teacher count is reported in the supplied overview.

chapters.label: Construction · family
chapters.title: Before systems, there were walls.
chapters.text: I worked in construction to help my parents, both on outside jobs and in our home. We partitioned our house to rent out space more than three times. Through almost every one of those changes, I built my own room.
chapters.note: That is where the construction language of this site comes from. It is not just a visual metaphor.

chapters.label: Autonomy · opportunity
chapters.title: The materials changed. The purpose stayed.
chapters.text: For a long time, I lacked some of the foundations I needed to pursue my dreams. Maybe that is why I love creating support for myself and for others. My parents built with bricks, mortar and sometimes drywall. Through programming, education and leadership, I found another way to build.

chapters.label: Questions · organizations
chapters.title: Ask the people already building.
chapters.text: Conversations with founders at Rio Innovation Week helped shape the first sketches of SOEL: an organization focused on education and academic olympiads.
chapters.note: Conceived in late 2023; formally founded in January 2025.

chapters.label: High school · olympiads
chapters.title: Turn curiosity into a practice.
chapters.text: Academic olympiads became a way to study deeply and find new paths. Mathematics, astronomy and chemistry are part of that foundation; economics is now the focus.

chapters.label: Leadership · priorities
chapters.title: Build something that outlasts one person.
chapters.text: At SOEL, I organized leadership, documentation and processes while teaching and building the organization’s ERP. I also joined Fundação Estudar’s Prep Program.

chapters.label: Research · product · strategy
chapters.title: From research to school. From school to new systems.
chapters.text: Education research became Sistema San. I became a Top 45 national finalist at OBECON and joined Tsugrowth to work on strategy and product. Public education, AI and building useful systems now connect the work.
chapters.note: Brazil’s Mendeleev team is part of the journey, not my current professional focus.

chapters.label: Horizon · goals
chapters.title: The next chapter is still being built.
chapters.text: Pursuing IEO 2027 and expanding the Sistema San pilot are goals. Studying Business and Computer Science is the next direction I want to explore.
chapters.note: Goals are not presented as completed achievements.
